title: Stage Strike
initial_explanation: Play rock-paper-scissors to decide who starts the Stage Strike process, or use the randomize button.
no_ruleset_error: No ruleset is selected. Please notify production/TO to select a ruleset.
commentary_load_failed: Could not load the commentary settings
commentary_casters_note: Checked "Show on stream" casters (up to {{max}}) appear on the overlay from left to right, in this order. Drag ⠿ to reorder. Names are suggested from the local player database.
commentary_display_limit: Up to {{max}} casters can be shown on stream
commentary_token_required: An access token is required. Open this page again with the URL that includes it
commentary_obs_step_2: Set its URL to the address below (use "Copy").
commentary_obs_step_3: Set the size to width 1920 / height 1080.
commentary_obs_note: While Autona is running, edits to the casters show on the OBS overlay in real time.
stream_load_failed: Could not load the stream settings
stream_token_required: An access token is required. Open this page again with the URL that includes it
stream_destination_note: Choose a saved stream channel, or type the destination URL.
stream_channel_required: Enter both the channel name and the URL.
stream_channel_missing: That channel was not found. The list was loaded again
stream_title_auto: Generated from the tournament info and the seeds
stream_title_typed: Typed by hand. Clear it to go back to the generated title
stream_org_note: The stream org's logo and thumbnail background: images of the stream channel, kept apart from each tournament's icon and banner.
stream_org_invalid: The image could not be read. Choose a PNG, JPEG or BMP image (up to 50 megapixels).
stream_org_too_large: The image is too large. Choose one of up to {{max}} MB.
stream_org_save_failed: The image could not be saved. Check that no other app has the file open.
stream_org_reset_confirm: The registered stream org icon and thumbnail will be removed. Continue?
stream_thumbnail_overlay: Put the org icon in the bottom-right corner
stream_thumbnail_no_org_thumbnail: No stream org thumbnail is registered.
stream_thumbnail_cancelled: Autona was closing: the thumbnail was not made.
stream_thumbnail_copy: Copy the thumbnail to the clipboard
stream_thumbnail_copied: Copied the thumbnail to the clipboard
stream_thumbnail_open_note: A page opened over http from another computer cannot put an image on the clipboard. Right-click the opened image to copy or save it.
stream_thumbnail_copy_unavailable: This view cannot put an image on the clipboard. Use the saved thumbnail (out/stream/).
event_load_failed: Could not load the tournament info
event_tournament_note: Paste the URL of the event's page on start.gg, or of the event's brackets page in the tournament's admin.
event_clear_confirm: Disconnect from the start.gg tournament? The selected game is forgotten too.
event_status_resolving: Finding the event of the admin URL…
event_status_unresolved: No event was found for this URL. Check that it is an event's brackets page in the tournament's admin.
event_status_load_failed: The tournament could not be loaded. Check that the URL is correct and points to an existing event, and try again.
event_url_invalid: Enter the URL of a start.gg event (https://www.start.gg/tournament/…/event/…) or of an event's brackets page in the admin.
event_busy: A tournament is being loaded. Try again once it is done.
event_info_note: Filled in when a tournament is loaded. What you type here stays until the next load.
event_game_busy: A game is being loaded. Try again once it is done.
event_entrants_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 999999.
event_colors_note: The colors every overlay uses unless a feature sets its own. Changing one sets every feature's color of that kind back to it.
event_media_note: Used by the overlays, the thumbnails and the result images. An image chosen here is scaled to 512 px (icon) or 1920 px (banner) on its long side.
event_media_reset_confirm: Set the tournament icon back to Autona's and remove the tournament banner?
event_media_no_media: The tournament has no icon or banner on start.gg.
event_media_fetch_failed: Could not download from start.gg. Check the connection and try again.
event_media_save_failed: The image could not be saved. Check that no other app has the file open.
event_media_superseded: The tournament changed during the download: nothing was saved.
event_media_queued: Downloads once the other tournament's download is done.
top8_load_failed: Could not load the Top 8 settings
top8_import_started: Loading the tournament results. The players and scores fill in when it is done.
top8_import_running: The tournament results are already loading. Try again when it is done.
top8_players_note: Slots 1-4 start in Winners, 5-8 in Losers. To change a pairing, swap the players.
top8_pick_refused: What you picked is not in the current list. Pick it again.
top8_countries_not_ready: The country list is still loading. Try again in a moment.
top8_pick_other_game: The game loaded had changed: nothing was written. Reading its character list again.
top8_countries_unavailable: The country data is not loaded yet: countries cannot be picked.
top8_characters_failed: Could not load the character list
top8_characters_unavailable: The character list of this game is not loaded: characters cannot be picked.
top8_reset_confirm: This resets every match's score and result. Continue?
top8_obs_note: While Autona is running, edits to the players and scores show on the OBS bracket in real time, as the scoreboard's do.
statspreview_load_failed: Could not load the stats display settings
statspreview_type_note: Pick the statistics overlay you want on stream; the preview and the OBS URL appear below. What it shows is the data fetched on the Statistics page.
statspreview_companion_note: A physical button on Bitfocus Companion can fetch the statistics (the same as "Fetch statistics" on the Statistics page). Set the request below on the Generic HTTP module.
statspreview_companion_copy_failed: Could not copy the request URL
statspreview_companion_guide: For the setup steps, open Help & Settings → API Settings → Companion settings in the app.
statspreview_companion_token: A Companion on another PC must send the access token in the X-Autona-Token header.
statspreview_obs_note: When you fetch the statistics again, the overlay in OBS updates in real time.
stats_refresh_started: Fetching the statistics. They appear here as start.gg answers.
stats_analysis_no_phases: This tournament has no phase groups.
stats_analysis_running: The match list is being fetched. Try again when it is done.
stats_analysis_read_failed: Could not read the match list.
players_no_tournament: No tournament loaded. Set a tournament URL in the EVENT panel.
players_team_hint: In team battle formats, this sets the first player of the team.
players_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this player? ({{key}})
players_no_game: Select a game to set this player's characters.
players_character_unknown: A name above is not a character of this game. Pick one from the list, or empty the field, to save.
players_game_changed: The game changed while this window was open. Characters, and a new sponsor or tag, cannot be saved here: close it and open it again.
players_save_characters_refused: {{names}}: this game's list does not have this character, color or variant, so it cannot be saved. Remove it with × to save.
players_load_not_found: This player is not in the player list, or the board has no slot for them.
players_save_refused: The player could not be saved. Check what was entered.
players_save_conflict: The game or this player changed while editing. Close this window and open it again if saving keeps failing.
players_countries_not_ready: The country data is still loading. Try again in a moment.
players_delete_gone: This player has already been deleted.
thumbnail_load_failed: Could not load the thumbnail settings
thumbnail_background_too_large: The image is too large (up to {{max}} MB)
thumbnail_background_invalid: The image could not be read (PNG, JPEG or BMP)
thumbnail_background_save_failed: The image could not be saved. Is another app holding the file?
thumbnail_use_team_names_note: Used in team and crew battles, where the teams have names
thumbnail_characters_no_game: Select a game to place its character images
thumbnail_out_of_range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
thumbnail_reset_confirm: Every game's settings and the uploaded background image go back to the defaults. This cannot be undone.
thumbnail_preview_failed_to_show: The preview could not be shown
thumbnail_cannot_render: Thumbnails are drawn by the desktop app. This Autona runs without a window (headless) and cannot draw them; the settings are still saved.
thumbnail_busy: A thumbnail is being generated already
thumbnail_error_no_player: Both sides of the match need a player
thumbnail_error_payload_failed: The template or the settings could not be read
thumbnail_error_render_failed: The thumbnail could not be drawn
thumbnail_error_save_failed: The thumbnail could not be saved
thumbnail_error_cancelled: Stopped as the app is closing
thumbnail_copy_unavailable: This view cannot put an image on the clipboard. Use the saved thumbnail (out/thumbnails/).
thumbnail_open_note: A page opened over http from another computer cannot put an image on the clipboard. Right-click the opened image to copy or save it.
thumbnail_video_title_placeholder: Made from the match once there is one
thumbnail_video_title_note: Made from the match. An edit here is not saved.
result_load_failed: Could not load the tournament result
result_no_game: Select a game to choose characters
result_import_running: The tournament results are being loaded
result_import_no_tournament: No tournament is set. Load one in the tournament information first.
result_import_error_fetch_failed: Could not get the tournament results. What you entered did not change. Please try again.
result_import_error_no_standings: This event has no standings yet. What you entered did not change.
result_import_error_changed: The game or the tournament changed while loading, so nothing was applied.
result_import_error_import_failed: Could not read the results received. What you entered did not change.
result_import_confirm_players: This overwrites what is entered for the singles layouts with the tournament results. It cannot be undone.
result_import_confirm_teams: This overwrites what is entered for the team layouts with the tournament results. It cannot be undone.
result_clear_confirm_players: This clears everything entered for the singles layouts (16 rows). What is entered for the team layouts stays. It cannot be undone.
result_clear_confirm_teams: This clears everything entered for the team layouts (8 teams). What is entered for the singles layouts stays. It cannot be undone.
result_rows_note: Reordering with the arrow buttons or by dragging the grip ranks the rows again from the top.
result_save_db_note: Saves the player names, sponsors, X handles and characters entered to the player list. The scoreboard's name suggestions and the handles in the X post use them. Making an image and posting on X save them too.
result_save_db_done: Saved {{count}} player(s) to the player list
result_save_db_none: There are no players to save
result_sample_note: No player name is entered, so a sample is shown.
result_background_note: The background follows the thumbnail's settings.
result_cannot_render: The desktop app draws the result. This Autona runs without a window (headless), so it cannot draw. What you enter is saved.
result_no_data: There is nothing to make. Enter at least one player name or team.
result_error_no_data: There is nothing to make. Enter at least one player name or team.
result_error_payload_failed: Could not read the template or the settings
result_error_cancelled: Cancelled because the app is closing
result_post_note: Post on X makes the image, copies it to the clipboard and opens the composer. Paste the image in the composer.
result_post_note_no_copy: A page opened over http from another computer cannot copy images to the clipboard. Post on X opens the composer: open and save the image made, and attach it.
result_post_token: Reading the post's text needs the access token. Open the page again with the URL that has the token.
result_post_failed: Could not read the post's text, so it cannot be posted yet.
result_row_refused: This value could not be saved. Check it and enter it again.
result_post_copied: Image copied. Paste it in the composer
result_post_copy_failed: Could not copy the image. Attach the saved image (out/results/)
board_load_failed: Could not load the scoreboard settings
board_no_design: No scoreboard design found in layout/.
board_design_refused: This design could not be chosen. The list was read again
board_popup_label: Show the winner popup on the preview
board_popup_note: Shown on this preview only. It does not affect OBS.
board_designer_description: Combine PNGs with player names and scores to make and edit new designs.
board_designer_tooltip: Opens the scoreboard Designer in a desktop window
board_obs_title: How to add it to OBS
board_obs_step_1: In OBS, add a "Browser" source under "Sources".
board_obs_step_2: Check "Local file" and give it the path below (use "Copy" or "Show in Explorer").
board_obs_step_3: Set the size to width 1920 / height 1080.
board_obs_popup_hint: When a match has its winner, shown with the name at the bottom center. Add it the same way, as a separate browser source.
board_obs_note: While Autona runs, the scores update live in OBS.
board_obs_token_required: The file paths are shown on this PC, or when opened with the token URL.
board_obs_load_failed: Could not load the file paths.
board_reveal_this_pc_only: Explorer can only be opened from the PC running Autona
board_reveal_changed: Another design is selected by now. The page has read it again
score_format_failed: Could not read the battle format. The board shown may be out of date.
score_pending_failed: Could not read the values not applied yet. The page shows the ones it read last.
score_other_dirty: The {{board}} scoreboard has edits not applied yet.
score_apply_tooltip: Show what was entered on the stream
score_open_sets: Choose a match of the tournament
score_open_sets_unavailable: The match selection opens on the desktop app only.
score_hide_sponsor: Do not show sponsor tags on the scoreboard
score_load_missing: That player is not in the player database any more.
score_post_missing: Cannot post to X: the following fields are empty.
score_post_token: Reading the post's text needs the access token. Open the page again with the URL that has the token.
score_post_failed: Could not read the post's text, so it cannot be posted yet.
score_post_copied: Thumbnail copied. Paste it in the composer
score_post_copy_failed: Could not copy the thumbnail. Attach the saved image (out/thumbnails/)
score_post_thumbnail_failed: Thumbnail generation failed, so no image was copied to the clipboard.
score_post_busy: A thumbnail is being made already: no image was copied.
score_post_no_render: This app cannot make thumbnails here: no image was copied.
score_post_reread: Reading the post's text again with what was just entered. Press Post on X once more.
score_load_no_slot: That player slot is no longer on the scoreboard.
